features.additionalInfo:
A range of rates
With an ANZ Advance Notice Term Deposit, you could potentially earn a higher interest rate in return for giving us 31 days’ notice for early withdrawals. This could help to maximise your savings. There’s a range of rates available for you to consider.

Various terms available
Choose a term that works for you, ranging from one month to five years. You can also select how often you receive interest payments – monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annually on selected terms.

No account service fees
Enjoy the benefits of an ANZ Advance Notice Term Deposit with no set-up costs or monthly account service fees.  Note that fees and charges will apply for early withdrawals.

Secure your savings
Locking away your savings could prevent frequent withdrawals. This could be a strategic way to grow your savings over time.

Government protection
Your deposits with ANZ may be protected under the Federal Government’s Financial Claims Scheme. Under the scheme, certain deposits up to a limit of $250,000 per account holder are protected. For more information, visit the ANZ Financial Claims Scheme page.

ANZ Progress Saver pays bonus interest (in addition to the current variable base interest) in respect of a particular month if the set minimum deposit (currently $10) and no withdrawals, fees or charges are processed to the account on or before the last business day of that calendar month, and after the last business day of the previous calendar month. Bonus and base rates are variable and subject to change.
